name: Scutarx
sum: Scutarx is a medium-sized armoured aetosaur from the Late Triassic Chinle Formation of Arizona.
wsnote: Described as medium-sized; no length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; named by Parker in 2016 from Petrified Forest National Park (PEFO).
material: Four partial skeletons with much of the carapace, vertebral column and shoulder and pelvic girdles, collected at PEFO between 2002 and 2009.
biology: Its fossils lie near the base of the Revueltian faunachron; the sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Parker 2016

sources.text: Parker, William 2016. Osteology of the Late Triassic aetosaur Scutarx deltatylus (Archosauria: Pseudosuchia). PeerJ 4. doi:10.7717/peerj.1583
